shortDescription: This module allow to managepipeline of an Elasticsearch installation

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The url used to connect with elasticsearch service

options.name: password
options.description: The password used to connect with elasticsearch service

options.name: ssl_verify
options.description: Choose to verify the ssl certificate or not

options.name: templates
options.description: This is a key value dictionary containing as key the name of the component template and as value the specifications The allowed keys for the subdictionary are: I(index_patterns), I(composed_of), I(data_stream), I(_meta), I(priority) or I(template).

options.name: user
options.description: The user used to connect with elasticsearch service
